ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 7
   C. 7
   D. 5

3. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

4. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 170
   C. 169
   D. 13

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 20
   C. 30
   D. 75

6. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 1/2
   C. They are equal
   D. Cannot tell

7. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 7
   C. 18
   D. 6

8. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 55
   B. 16
   C. 22
   D. 32

9. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 4
   C. 33
   D. 12

10. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 6
   B. 1, 2, 3, 6
   C. 2, 4, 6
   D. 3, 6, 9

11. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

12. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 121
   C. 22
   D. 122

13. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

14. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 7

15. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

16. Solve for x: x + 3 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 12
   C. 3
   D. 9

17. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

18. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 82

19. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 156

20. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

21. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 2
   C. 49
   D. 14

22. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.7
   C. 21
   D. 15.6

23. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 11
   C. 24
   D. 25

24. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 24
   C. 12
   D. 36

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
